address: 23F The Shilla Hotel, 249 Dongho-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, 04605, South Korea
bio: If you are looking for a refined French restaurant with all the elements of classic French luxury, Continental is a solid bet. Perched on the 23rd floor of The Shilla Seoul, the restaurant is decorated in rich colors, with large tables and French empire chairs. What’s more, the bright dining room offers diners a fantastic view of the city. The meticulously prepared food is beautifully plated and served on two different set menus of your choice....
